decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The agreement floor space shall be used for A1 or A3 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of any part of the development, details of any external ventilation/ extraction system and plant or equipment including appropriate soundproofing shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the units shall not be constructed otherwise than in accordance with such approval.  The proposed plant should be inaudible when assessed from the site boundary and sound levels should be 10db(A) below measured background noise levels to ensure that residents are not disturbed by the plant

Condition : 5 - 5.	Prior to first opening of the A1 or A3 Use, details of the servicing operation, including hours of servicing, numbers of deliveries, access to the service yard etc, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. The scheme so approved shall be fully implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  7am to 7pm Mondays to Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 8 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 9 - The access doorway to the building shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Construction of building 5 to comprise a five storey building comprising business use and a retail (use class A1) or restaurant (use class A3) element at ground floor level
